_readme: 1.12.1 addons (Vanilla private servers and Turtle WoW), built like wotlk335.json by the 'Private server addon catalogs' workflow. A repo is kept only when its TOC says Interface 110xx to 112xx, so Classic Era addons stay out.

addons.name: pfUI
addons.summary: A full interface replacement: unit frames, action bars, bags, chat and more.

addons.name: pfQuest
addons.summary: Quest givers, objectives, mobs and items on your map, with a database browser.

addons.name: pfQuest Turtle WoW data
addons.summary: Adds Turtle WoW's own quests and zones to pfQuest.

addons.name: ShaguTweaks
addons.summary: Small quality of life changes to the default interface, each one a switch.

addons.name: ShaguDPS
addons.summary: A light damage and healing meter.

addons.name: ShaguPlates
addons.summary: Nameplates with health, cast bars and debuffs.
